topic: Analyzing session duration and permanent data
summary_markdown: The conversation covered using the staging MOPs environment for comparison with production data. A specific query was discussed regarding how permanent records are included when filtering by `is_calibrated=1`. It was confirmed that permanent records *are* included in this filter, requiring an additional condition to exclude them if necessary. The discussion shifted to analyzing unusually long average session durations observed during a commute. It was clarified that the filters for these metrics (like average session duration) are independent of each other and should be applied to recalculated data, not real-time data.
decisions: The staging MOPs environment can be used for comparison with production data.
action_items: [p1] will review the data in detail to analyze average session duration and facility metrics.
